item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya's school in Pune wants to manage its garden in a way that supports ecosystem health. Her teacher lists four possible practices.
For the garden to support ecosystem health, the practice must reduce pollution, protect biodiversity, keep the soil healthy, and remain sustainable over many years.
Which practice best supports ecosystem health?

options.A: Spraying chemical pesticides every week so that no insects at all are found in the garden
options.B: Replacing all the plants with one fast-growing vegetable crop to get the biggest harvest
options.C: Using compost from kitchen waste, growing a variety of local plants, and watering with collected rainwater
options.D: Burning the dry leaves and waste in the garden corner to clear the space quickly
